concerns.text: Task T011 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it orchestrates the entire end‑to‑end pipeline (executes T003–T010) and writes global metadata. Running it in parallel with any other task could cause race conditions or incomplete artifact generation, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T012 is also tagged `[P]` yet it creates a deterministic archive that must contain the final state of *all* previous artifacts. If executed concurrently with earlier tasks the archive could miss files or capture a partially‑written state, making the `[P]` designation incorrect.
